profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Western Governors University and Founder of StratFolio AI

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: stratfolioai.com - StratFolio AI is a direct-to-consumer AI financial intelligence platform delivering real-time portfolio insights against news and market data, along with customizable AI algorithmic derivative trading features.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scaled Fanduel Racing from prototype to 100,000+ users while owning performance testing and Kubernetes/backend scaling decisions, owning third party integrations with United Tote/Equibase/PayNearMe, owning Fanduel Racing’s Kafka financial streaming platform, building and owning multiple microservices, and acting as the go-to production issue firefighter.
Onboarded and mentored a new team as the only backend engineer on the US Racing team.
Also acted as Tech Lead to launch Fanduel Picks and Fanduel Lottery.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Performance Tuning · Microsoft SQL Server · Claude Code · Microservices · Spring Framework · Java · Software Systems Engineering · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cursor AI · Kubernetes · Google Cloud Platform
